meridian/credits-agreement-release-1.0: Meridian Credits release 1.0 credit agreement (finance approved; source: beads issue trial-5mh). Applicability: every quote request naming release "1.0"; an omitted release selects the current agreement, which is 1.0 as of 2026-09-08. Rules: each charge line's uncapped credit is 10% of charge_cents, rounded down separately to integer cents. Cap: 2400 cents shared by all lines with the same account_id, across its subscriptions; distinct account_id groups have independent caps. Priority within a cap group: earliest service_on first; equal service dates by increasing line_id (Unicode code-point order); each line receives its uncapped credit up to the group remaining cap, later lines receive only the remainder or zero. Totals: total credit = sum of assigned line credits; line amount_due_cents = charge_cents - assigned credit; total due = total charges - total credit. Line schema: exactly line_id, account_id, subscription_id (nonempty strings; line_id unique within a request; subscription identified by (account_id, subscription_id) pair); service_on is a valid Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD in 2020-01-01..2099-12-31; charge_cents is a nonnegative integer of US cents. Each request is the complete charge set of one independently quoted monthly statement, so caps apply within that set; line collections may be empty. Implemented in main.py (assign_credits_1_0/quote_1_0); single-line quote treats the supplied line as the entire statement. Unsupported explicit releases currently return {"error":"unsupported_release"} (not specified by the agreement; revisit if a later issue defines it).
